title: TTS serverless worker input (tts-serverless/v1)
description: RunPod serverless input: one Russian phrase, voice/parameter snapshot and render/aligner settings. The worker loads the pinned Qwen3-TTS model from its own image/volume and never receives a model choice.

request_id.description: Application request UUID; echoed back in the output so batched phrase runs can be matched.

text.description: Phrase text. Normalization (numbers, abbreviations, brands, stress — data dictionaries) happens inside the worker (contract §1.2).

language.description: Voice language of the phrase; the product voices are Russian.

mode.description: Voice mode. v1 has presets only; clone/VoiceDesign are additive later.

speaker_id.description: Preset speaker index in the pinned model's voice catalog.

takes.description: Number of takes to synthesize (plan §7.2: 1–2). Default 1.

seed.description: Optional seed; null means the engine's default sampling. The reported take seed is the execution fact.

start.description: Phrase window start on the scenario timeline (seconds).

end.description: Phrase window end on the scenario timeline (seconds); must be > start.

window.description: Tracing data only: the worker does NOT fit/stretch the phrase to the window (contract §1.3). Overflow is handled by the service.

sample_rate.description: Requested output sample rate. Qwen3-TTS is 24 kHz native; resampling is the engine boundary's job.

format.description: Container format. v1 is WAV (PCM); mp3/opus are additive later.

enabled.description: Run the GigaAM-v3 aligner/QC (words + WER). Default true. When false: words=[] and wer=null in the output.

word_timestamps.description: Return word timestamps. Default true. With enabled=true and false: WER is still measured, words are [] (aligner runs, timings omitted).

policy.description: Optional RunPod policy (executionTimeout/ttl). The worker does not read it; RunPod applies it before the handler runs.
